title: 4,725 Wires, ~$1.1 Billion: What the JPMorgan Number Actually Means

core_claim.scope: Epstein and associates; wires through Epstein's JPMorgan accounts

evidence_boundaries: The complete 4,725-row transaction ledger is not public in the cited Senate materials.
The aggregate does not identify one single payer or recipient.
The existence of a transfer does not establish criminal purpose or counterparty knowledge.
The ~$1.1 billion wire aggregate is distinct from the ~$1.283 billion combined amount of the two 2019 SARs.
